draft.subject: Re: Quick check-in from Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Jordan,

Great to hear the first project is starting to click -- that's the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so it's a good base to build on. Your SSO question is closed out on our side; happy to pick it back up anytime.

The one thing still missing is your team. A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Want me to walk you through that first invite this week? Just reply with a time and I'll make it quick.

Best,
Priya
